purpose: Repair observed binary relay-action entropy collapse before any candidate-method implementation.

entropy_coef.rationale: Two of three V6 training seeds collapsed to always reconstruct across every public profile, with concurrent collision/timeout failures.

frozen_pass_conditions.future_profiles: For each future-required profile, at least 2/3 training seeds have endpoint success in [0.10, 0.90].
frozen_pass_conditions.current_profiles: Both current-required profiles have non-zero mean success.
frozen_pass_conditions.stage_behavior: Future-profile mean postbranch reconstruct fraction minus prebranch fraction is at least 0.15.

next_step_only_if_pass: Implement the capacity-matched public stage-conditioned relation-value candidate and its semantic-shuffle ablation.
